## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] refactor — no behavior change
- [ ] chore / ci / build
- [ ] test

## Checklist

- [ ] Branched off `main` with a `type/` prefix; commits follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` is clean.
- [ ] `npm run lint` is clean.
- [ ] `npm test` is green.
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds.
- [ ] No fabricated data — any missing data is surfaced honestly and noted in `docs/known-differences.md`.
- [ ] Key-gated features degrade to "coming soon", not errors.
- [ ] Design tokens used (no hardcoded colors); looks right in light and dark.
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior, architecture, or status changed (SPEC / ARCHITECTURE / FEATURES / STATUS as relevant).
- [ ] If the schema changed: migration added and `scripts/seed.ts` updated.
